seoTitle: How to Add Google Docs as a Source in NotebookLM
metaDescription: Import Google Docs into NotebookLM by linking your Drive account and selecting files, so you can summarize, query, and analyze your documents with AI.
intro: NotebookLM can turn your Google Docs into a research assistant that summarizes and answers questions grounded in your own writing. This guide covers setting up a notebook workspace, linking your Google Drive account, and selecting specific documents so NotebookLM can parse and cite them accurately during your research sessions.

steps.heading: Open the NotebookLM dashboard
steps.body: Launch NotebookLM and create a fresh notebook workspace dedicated to your research project.

steps.heading: Trigger the Add Source panel
steps.body: Open the source overlay and select the native Google Drive integration path to connect your account.

steps.heading: Locate your target document
steps.body: Use the file picker to search and select the specific Google Docs asset you want to add as a source.

steps.heading: Grant read permissions
steps.body: Allow the necessary background access so NotebookLM's AI can accurately parse your document's text.

steps.heading: Review the initial summary
steps.body: Once processed, check your sources dashboard and run an initial summary to confirm the content was analyzed correctly.

steps.heading: Test interactive queries
steps.body: Ask questions in the chat interface to evaluate how accurately NotebookLM cites and references your source text.

faq.question: Do I need to give NotebookLM full access to my Google Drive?
faq.answer: You only need to grant read permission for the specific documents you add as sources, not your entire Drive account.

faq.question: Can I add multiple Google Docs to the same notebook?
faq.answer: Yes, you can link multiple documents as sources within one notebook to build a broader research base for your queries.

faq.question: Will NotebookLM update automatically if I edit my source document later?
faq.answer: You may need to re-sync or re-add the source manually to reflect significant edits made after the initial import.

faq.question: How does formatting my document with clear headers help NotebookLM?
faq.answer: Clear headers improve NotebookLM's ability to accurately track citations and generate more precise, well-organized responses.
